svg.title: Maintain, predict and plan with IBM Maximo Application Suite
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Maintain: work orders, asset history and maintenance processes. Predict: analytics and sensor data that detect issues early, for condition-based maintenance. Plan: compare maintain, refurbish or replace scenarios against risk, cost and budget.
